name: Sass
description: Automatically compile SCSS and Sass files after saving.

configWorkspace.title: Enable compile Sass on Save
configWorkspace.description: Compile local SCSS and Sass files after saving in this project.

configWorkspace.title: CSS Style
configWorkspace.description: Controls the output style of the resulting CSS.

configWorkspace.title: Error CSS
configWorkspace.description: Tells Sass whether to emit a CSS file when an error occurs during compilation.

configWorkspace.title: Generate Source Map
configWorkspace.description: Source maps are files that tell browsers or other tools that consume CSS how that CSS corresponds to the Sass files from which it was generated. They make it possible to see and even edit your Sass files in browsers.

configWorkspace.title: Update Path
configWorkspace.description: Input file or directory, relative to the workspace root (or the saved Sass file's directory when relative paths are enabled). Leave blank for automatic directory selection.

configWorkspace.title: Output Path
configWorkspace.description: Output directory (or CSS filename for a single input file), relative to the workspace root unless relative paths are enabled. Leave blank to output beside the entry points.

configWorkspace.title: Resolve Paths Relative to Sass File
configWorkspace.description: Resolve Update Path and Output Path from the saved Sass file's directory instead of the workspace root.

configWorkspace.title: Sass Executable
configWorkspace.description: Select a detected Sass installation or enter a custom executable path.

configWorkspace.title: Check Sass Installation
configWorkspace.description: Verify the selected or automatically detected Sass executable and display its version.
